lines.text: بحسب دلخواه نباشد پس بجهت اصلاح اینفساد یکی از سعدین جهد باید کرد که در طالع یا عاشر
lines.en: is not according to desire, then for the sake of correcting this corruption, one must strive for one of the two benefics to be in the ascendant or the tenth,

lines.text: باشد چه طالع دلیل مبداء امور است و عاشر دلیل اعمال و اشغال و اگر مصلح نیز میسر نشود
lines.en: because the ascendant is the indicator of the beginning of affairs and the tenth is the indicator of actions and occupations. And if a corrector is also not possible,

lines.text: لیکن صاحب بیت قمر مسعود بود عند الضروره جایز باشد غایتش آنکه انمهم در ابتدا فاسد
lines.en: but the lord of the house of the Moon is fortunate, it is permissible in case of necessity. The utmost of it is that that important matter is corrupt in the beginning

lines.text: و ضایع گردد و در انتها بصلاح باز اید و ضروریات موعوده بختیار عند ضیق الوقت بهمین تمام
lines.en: and is lost, and in the end it returns to correctness. And the promised necessities by choice, when time is tight, are completed by this.

lines.text: که مذکور شد اما اموریکه رعایت آن سبب کمال اختیار بود بسیار است و مصنف از انجمله یک
lines.en: which was mentioned. But the matters whose observance is the cause of the perfection of the choice are many, and the author, from among them, one

lines.text: جزء که البق و افید است اختصار نموده میفرماید که در اختیارات نهاری اولی و انسب
lines.en: part which is more fitting and more useful, has summarized and says that in diurnal choices, it is more appropriate and more suitable

lines.text: آن بود که طالع و برج قمر بروج نهاری بود و در اختیارات لیلی بروج لیلی بروج
lines.en: that the ascendant and the sign of the Moon be diurnal signs, and in nocturnal choices, nocturnal signs. Nocturnal signs

lines.text: نهاری دلیل قبل از این در باب ششم نزد هم ذکر یافته اما محذورات اختیار بسیار است انچه
lines.en: diurnal, the reason before this in the sixth chapter near each other has been mentioned. But the caveats of choice are many. That which

lines.text: جمهور بر آن متفق اند انت که می باید قمر تحت الشعاع و مجاسده کید و ذنب و در طریقه
lines.en: the majority agree upon is that the Moon must be under the rays and in bodily conjunction with the Head and Tail [of the Dragon] and in the combust way

lines.text: محترقه و محصور بین النحسین و خالی السیر و وحشی السیر نباشد و خلاء السیر او اعمست از انکه
lines.en: and besieged between the two malefics and void of course and wild of course, and its void of course is more general than that

lines.text: منصرف از نحسی باشد یا از سعدی الا انکه انصراف او از نحس اشد است و بعضی نظر عداوت
lines.en: it is separating from a malefic or from a benefic, except that its separation from a malefic is more severe. And some [consider] the aspect of enmity

lines.text: میانه خدا وند خانه قمر و قمر و همچنین نظر عداوت قمر با نحوس و سقوط او از طالع و وقوع
lines.en: between the lord of the house of the Moon and the Moon, and also the aspect of enmity of the Moon with the malefics, and its fall from the ascendant, and the occurrence

lines.text: او در او بال و در اواخر بروج که حدود نحسین است و بطوء السیر و هبوط او در جنوب
lines.en: of it in detriment and in the last degrees of the signs which are the terms of the two malefics, and slowness of course, and its fall in the south

lines.text: از جمله محذورات شمرده اند و ایضاً می باید که نیرین هیچکدام در طالع نباشند زیرا که
lines.en: have counted among the caveats. And also it is necessary that neither of the two luminaries be in the ascendant, because

lines.text: طالع مشترکست میانه نور و ظلمت پس هرگاه حلول نیرین در طالع اتفاق افتد چون انضوء
lines.en: the ascendant is shared between light and darkness. So whenever the entry of the two luminaries in the ascendant happens, since that light

lines.text: کواکب اند هر آئینه طالع بر حالت طبیعی نماند و در اختیارات باعث عوارض مکروهه گردد
lines.en: are planets, inevitably the ascendant does not remain in its natural state, and in choices it causes detestable accidents.

lines.text: و مخفی نماند که در مداخل محققه اینفن بهمین در باب قمر بنظر رسیده و امام رحمة الله سبب
lines.en: And let it not remain hidden that in the verified introductions of this art, this same thing regarding the Moon has been seen, and the Imam, may God have mercy on him, the cause

lines.text: آن از ابوالمعشر حکیم چنینی نقلنموده که ماه در غایت رطوبت است پس تاثیرات غریبه در
lines.en: of it from Abu Ma'shar the philosopher has transmitted thus: that the Moon is in the utmost of moisture, so strange effects in

lines.text: وی بسهولت ظاهر شود و چون در طالع بود مضرات عظیم در وی پدید آید بسبب آن تشترک
lines.en: it appear with ease. And when it is in the ascendant, great harms appear in it because of that sharing.

summary.headline: Electional Astrology: Lunar Cautions
summary.text: Rules and cautions for electional choices: place benefics in the ascendant or tenth house when correcting a corrupt election, align diurnal or nocturnal signs with the time, and avoid lunar combustion, conjunction with the Dragon’s Head or Tail, besiegement by malefics, void of course, hostile aspects, detriment, late degrees, and southern fall. Abu Ma'shar’s explanation of the Moon’s excessive moisture and harmful effects in the ascendant is cited.
